name: Dual Command Interface
desc: An experimental implant interface allows two officers to form a "neural bridge" to share their thoughts and skills. This "drift" involves melding memories, instinct, and emotions to act as one consciousness. Test pilots report several behavioral anomalies after the link is severed, able to predict and read their co-pilots for an extended period.
short: Allows a co-pilot to serve aboard.

name: Dual Command Interface (Module Link)
desc: Links a station module to its parent ship's co-pilot.
